summary: Esquire Financial Holdings filed an 8-K announcing receipt of all regulatory approvals for its merger with Signature Bancorporation. No price per share, premium, or deal terms are disclosed in this filing; it solely updates on regulatory clearance. The transaction, expected to close pending conditions, positions Esquire as the acquirer. The press release includes forward-looking statements on cost savings and synergies. Watch for the final closing date and any last-minute regulatory or shareholder issues; the risk-arb spread will tighten as the deal nears completion.
